verdicts.quote: The admin may reselect and resubmit the same file as a fresh attempt. … No automatic retry, cancellation action, saved import history, background-processing commitment, completion notification or downloadable report is required.
verdicts.missing: Cancellation is explicitly optional and retries use a fresh upload. The specification gives no action to select just the reported failing rows for retry.

verdicts.missing: There is no processing-time bound for a maximum-size file. The pending indicator does not show how much of the file has been processed.
